headline: Cristiano Ronaldo's 90-min pay exceeds 470 years of salary for 1st grade govt official
summary: A staggering comparison reveals the massive wealth gap between global sports superstars and high-ranking government employees.
details: Cristiano Ronaldo's earnings for a single 90-minute match are reportedly higher than what a first-grade government official earns in 470 years.
The comparison highlights the astronomical scale of salaries in professional football, particularly for elite players like Ronaldo.
While first-grade government officials hold some of the most senior positions in the civil service, their lifetime earnings are dwarfed by the superstar's per-match income.
This disparity underscores the global commercialization of sports and the immense brand value associated with top-tier athletes.

headline: Friendly match: Brazil-supporting police beat Argentina-supporting police
summary: Police officers in Bangladesh divide themselves into Brazil and Argentina fans for a lighthearted football match.
details: Police officers organized a friendly football match to celebrate their passion for the World Cup.
The officers split into two teams based on their support for the football giants, Brazil and Argentina.
In a spirited contest, the team supporting Brazil emerged victorious over the Argentina-supporting side.
The event served as a way for the officers to relax and bond through their shared love for the sport.
